productWorkerDefinition.bundle: Exact worker.js bytes bound by immutable v7 execution freeze and its bundle input manifest; production acoustic-worker.entry.ts is the entry.
productWorkerDefinition.owner: The single run-level native Worker wrapped by AcousticModelWorker in immutable v7 entry.ts. Browser URL evidence and trace constructions must both equal 1.

ortRuntimeWorkerDefinition.classification: Subordinate implementation of the one frozen ORT runtime/session; not by itself a second product acoustic Worker, model session or fallback model.
ortRuntimeWorkerDefinition.cardinalityGate: No universal fixed ORT worker count. Preserve observed count and require every non-product Worker to bind this exact runtime asset.

unexpectedWorkerDefinition: Any other pathname, mixed browser origins, non-loopback/full foreign origin, query/fragment or noncanonical backslash URL. Unexpected count must be 0.
independentRationale: Frozen production source ownership and pre-existing canonical Continuous Worker-presence gate; independently classify all eight immutable v7 musical cells. Current ORT count 3 is a witness observation, not the general product invariant.
readPolicy: Before remote taxonomy proof, Stage A output/seal may only be raw-hashed. Afterwards read only whitelisted accounting/model/Worker/input-hash metadata using a selective JSON projector; never materialize decoded publications, pitches/confidence or truth/scenario content.
executionPolicy: Standard-library audit only. Security audit hook denies non-Git subprocesses, inference/browser/audio SDK imports and OS execution APIs. No browser, decoder, PCM generation, source-runtime execution or model loading.
output: Additive downstream eligibility seal only; never modify the original acoustic output or seal, never mark the original v7 gate PASS.
